description.content:
Create a chat completion using a Letta agent (OpenAI-compatible).

This endpoint provides full OpenAI API compatibility. The agent is selected based on:
- The 'model' parameter in the request (should contain an agent ID in format 'agent-...')

When streaming is enabled (stream=true), the response will be Server-Sent Events
with ChatCompletionChunk objects.

response.name: Successful response

REST API for Letta, the stateful agents platform. Manage agents, memory blocks, archival passages, sources, custom tools, MCP servers, multi-agent groups, runs, and streaming responses. Available as Letta Cloud (managed) at https://api.letta.com/v1 and as the self-hosted open-source server (Apache-2.0) typically run at http://localhost:8283.
